long_description:
Teaching Yoga through a Trauma-Informed Lens - 8 hour training for yoga teachers

TUESDAY | OCT 13 | 6:00-8:30pm Livestream on Zoom

AND

FRIDAY | OCT 23 | 1:00-6:30pm In-person at Yoga Sanctuary

Cost $179 | HYTT grads $129

Would you like to learn how to create inclusive spaces for students who have experienced trauma?

This training will provide a solid foundation of understanding for you to create and teach yoga classes that help students heal, integrate, and come back into the body. Topics of study include:

-Neurobiology of Trauma - Explore how trauma affects the physical body and the nervous system including polyvagal theory.

-Creating a Safe Space - Learn how to use clear, empowering language and sequencing to foster a sense of choice, security and agency.

-Awareness of Racial and Generational Trauma - Understand how systemic oppression can manifest in the body.

-Ethical Considerations - Understand the scope of a yoga teacher's role and when it's appropriate to refer students to mental health professionals.

-Embodied Practices - Explore specific techniques, such as grounding and breathwork, that can help students reconnect with their bodies at their own pace.

After study and discussion, we will also dig in with a teaching lab. This enables each person to practice how to teach these elements with mentored support and constructive feedback. The heart of Trauma-Informed teachings is about sharing power and stepping into your own agency - so this isn’t a dogmatic list of “do or don’t”. Discussion will be encouraged as each person experiments with which elements of the Trauma-Informed model best suits their teaching style.

This training of “Teaching Yoga Through a Trauma-Informed Lens” is eligible for 8 hours of Yoga Alliance Continuing Education for yoga teachers. Live attendance at all meetings is necessary to receive a CEU certificate.
